Install hex on Omarchy

Hex voice dictation app by Anomaly: hold a key, speak, and it types (Linux beta; not the hex dump tool)

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add hex-bin
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 3.0.0-1:
    pacman -Qi hex-bin

Open and use hex

To see what the package installed, including any commands and desktop entries:

pacman -Ql hex-bin

Frequently asked questions

How do I install hex on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add hex-bin. The download is 21.8 MB and it takes 57 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is hex free?

Check the project site for current pricing. The package is licensed MIT.

How do I uninstall hex?

Run omarchy pkg drop hex-bin. It removes the package from your system.

What does hex depend on?

The package declares 13 dependencies: alsa-lib, curl, gcc-libs, glibc, libx11, libxcb, libxcursor, libxi, libxkbcommon, libxkbcommon-x11, openblas, vulkan-icd-loader and more. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is hex in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as hex-bin (version 3.0.0-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. Anomaly makes it. Project site: https://github.com/anomalyco/hex.
